_note: v2 hooks for Maisons de prière (B43). Respectful coverage of many faiths; no offensive shortcuts.

fr_religion_noun.hook: Reverent: like "religion", said ruh-lee-ZHYOHN: people of many faiths gather peacefully outside their places of worship.

fr_juif_adj.hook: Reverent: a JEWISH family lights Shabbat candles together on a Friday evening.

fr_temple_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "temple", said TAHNPL: a quiet PROTESTANT CHURCH, or temple, in the village.

fr_pasteur_noun.hook: Reverent: a kind PASTOR greets his congregation at the church door.

fr_culte_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "cult", said KEWLT: a congregation gathers quietly for WORSHIP in a small chapel.

fr_musulman_adj.hook: Reverent: linked to "Muslim", said mew-zewl-MAHN: a MUSLIM family walks to the mosque at sunset with prayer mats.

fr_orthodoxe_adj.hook: Reverent: like "Orthodox", said or-toh-DOKS: an ORTHODOX church with onion domes and gold icons.

fr_protestant_noun.hook: Reverent: like "protestant", said proh-tehs-TAHN: a simple white PROTESTANT chapel with a plain wooden cross.

fr_ramadan_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Ramadan", said rah-mah-DAHN: families share dates at sunset to break the RAMADAN fast.

fr_rabbin_noun.hook: Reverent: like "rabbi", said rah-BAN: a RABBI reads from scrolls at the synagogue lectern.

fr_synagogue_noun.hook: Reverent: like "synagogue", said see-nah-GOG: a SYNAGOGUE with a Star of David above the door.

fr_torah_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Torah", said toh-RAH: a TORAH scroll is carefully unrolled on a velvet cloth.

fr_pagode_noun.hook: Reverent: like "pagoda", said pah-GOD: a tiered PAGODA with golden bells.

fr_kippa_noun.hook: Reverent: like "kippah", said kee-PAH: a knitted KIPPAH skullcap rests on a prayer book.

fr_chretien_adj.hook: Reverent: linked to "Christian", said kray-TYAN: a CHRISTIAN family walks quietly into a village church on Sunday.

fr_christianisme_noun.hook: Reverent: like "christianity", said krees-tyah-NEEZM: a quiet country chapel with a simple cross, symbol of CHRISTIANITY.

fr_shabbat_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Sabbath", said shah-BAH: two candles glow on a table set for the SABBATH meal.

fr_coran_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Qur'an", said koh-RAHN: a beautifully bound QUR'AN rests on a carved wooden stand.

fr_minaret_noun.hook: Reverent: like "minaret", said mee-nah-REH: a slender MINARET rises against the evening sky.

fr_imam_noun.hook: Reverent: like "imam", said ee-MAHM: an IMAM leads prayers in a calm, carpeted hall.

fr_islam_noun.hook: Reverent: like "islam", said ee-SLAHM: a calligraphy panel and prayer rug represent ISLAM.
